cause_quote: The commit added `updateSlashMenu(target.value, state, slashMenuHost, requestUpdate);` to the textarea selection handler, so selecting text ran the argument refresh that set `state.slashMenuIndex = 0`.
user_saw: After highlighting `ultra` in the `/think` menu and selecting text with Shift+Left Arrow, pressing Tab completed `default`.
summary: The fix preserves the highlighted argument by value when the slash menu refreshes for the same draft.
reasoning: The parent already supported keyboard argument completion, and its textarea selection handler refreshed only the skill menu, leaving the highlighted slash argument available for Tab. PR #122425 added a slash-menu refresh to that handler, routing an unchanged argument draft through the existing index reset.
